facts.fact: National Savings Recurring Deposit (post office RD): 5 years, minimum Rs 100 per month, no maximum, so Rs 500 a month fits
facts.quote: 2 National Savings Recurring Deposit Account 5 Years Minimum Rs. 100/- per month. No maximum limit.

facts.fact: Public Provident Fund: 15 years, minimum Rs 500 and maximum Rs 1,50,000 in a financial year
facts.quote: 8 Public Provident Fund Scheme 15 Years Minimum Rs. 500/- & Maximum Rs. 150000/- in a F.Y.

facts.fact: Sukanya Samriddhi Account (for a girl child): 21 years, minimum Rs 250 and maximum Rs 1,50,000 in a financial year
facts.quote: 9 Sukanya Samriddhi Account 21 Years Minimum Rs. 250/- & Maximum Rs. 150000/- in a F.Y.

behaviour: Lists government small-savings schemes that accept Rs 500 a month (e.g. Post Office RD, PPF, Sukanya Samriddhi) with their minimum deposits as published by NSI (nsiindia.gov.in), in Hinglish; gives no advice on which to choose.
fail_if: It recommends one scheme for the user, or gives minimum deposits that differ from NSI.
summary: Added NSI at-a-glance minimums as examples: RD Rs 100/month, PPF Rs 500/FY, SSY Rs 250/FY (max Rs 1.5 lakh/FY for PPF and SSY).
